_comment: Literature reference temperatures (not all are measured Widom maxima: Kim 2017 = apparent kappa_T maximum inferred from S(0); Holten & Anisimov 2012 = candidate critical point; Mishima 2010 = assumed liquid-liquid critical-point location). Role of these points in the original parameter selection is not documented; see docs/PROVENANCE.md. They are reported here as literature comparison values, not as independent out-of-fit validation.

anchors.label: Kim et al. 2017 (apparent kappa_T maximum, X-ray scattering)
anchors.reference: K. H. Kim et al., Science 358, 1589 (2017)

anchors.label: Holten & Anisimov 2012 (candidate liquid-liquid critical point)
anchors.reference: V. Holten and M. A. Anisimov, Sci. Rep. 2, 713 (2012)
